{{Top}}
[[File:KyleKatarn-academygrad.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Kyle Katarn]], cadet of the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]].]]

Those who were enrolled at the [[Imperial Academy/Legends|Imperial Academies]] were called '''cadets'''. The term was also used before then, during the time of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], for the same purpose when [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were being trained. The main facility where many of these cadets were trained at were academies such as the [[Carida Academy/Legends|Academy of Carida]], where many famous [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] have been trained.

A similar rank, called "recruit," was utilized by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] post-Battle of Hoth, being the lowest rank, just below [[Flight Cadet]]. Its insignia was a white patch with white borders and completely bare.
